comments.body: Not reproducible with a single member — needs at least three.

content.text: Not reproducible with a single member — needs at least three.
Steps to reproduce: open billing plan switcher with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
